Completed: initial website established, mobile navigation improved, Reflections page featuring 'Coherence: A Quiet Harmony of Being Yourself' with its original RGuytano artwork, archive ready to grow. Remaining work, from Robert's revisions conversation with Charli, supplied verbatim 2026-11-17: (1) establish the identity of RYE Book I (the original published Remembering You're Extraordinary, given its rightful prominence) and Book II (the second edition, RYE 2.0), before expanding commercial material; (2) consolidate the RYE 2.0 material and decide its presentation, distinguishing the book project from individual essays and reflections (not yet finalized); (3) rebuild the content hierarchy around Books, Reflections, and About, with Coherence represented appropriately and the Shop secondary, revisiting homepage, navigation, and destinations; (4) develop the Coherence collection: complete 'Living Coherence: A Gentle Return to Yourself' and introduce it on the site with links to the related Substack reflections and the finished Etsy guide (the three movements How It Feels, What It Looks Like, and The Archetype of Coherence are provisional); (5) integrate the five existing Etsy guides (Reflective Listening Guide, The Kind of Love We Want, Holding Grief Gently, Growing Older Beautifully, When Something No Longer Fits) into the larger RYE ecosystem without the shop dominating the site's identity; (6) continue developing Reflections: feature the newest reflection, move previous entries into The Archive on the MarkhamIdeas.org pattern, and do not duplicate the featured article in the archive.
